timeline: Cluster scheduler upgrade on {2023-11-05} introduced MPI runtime dependency conflicts with scratch storage filesystem changes; field-station telemetry pipeline reprocessed monthly tables from {2023-11-06} onward, showing 7% missing quality flags and 4% erroneous tide-stage values in variant-3 firmware stations.
causal_chain: Scheduler upgrade triggered MPI runtime incompatibility with scratch storage changes; missing alerts were the cluster’s default ‘no error’ return code for unhandled filesystem events; pipeline skipped reprocessing of variant-3 firmware telemetry due to flag-not-delete cleaning rules, masking storm-event spikes as suspect values.
blast_radius: Affected stations: all 18 with variant-3 firmware (6 stations); reprocessed data: monthly tables from {2023-11-06} onward; downstream impact: executive dashboards show 12% missing tide-stage metrics, triggering manual review at {2023-11-15}.
remediation: Immediate: patch MPI runtime to support scratch filesystem (owner=cluster-team, priority=critical); systemic: audit firmware variants for filesystem compatibility (owner=engineering-lead, due={2023-11-20}); verify reprocessing idempotency with property-based tests on {2023-11-18}; residual risk: 2% variant-4 stations may fail if their firmware lacks patch support.
